answer: Admission auction: each epoch sells a few non-transferable entry permits to the highest bidders, and the winning bid is burned. An umber stamp marks a permit genuine; past the velvet rope only holders trade. Each newcomer crosses a tundra. 100 fakes cost 100 bids at 40 credits each: 4,000 credits burned before one trade, against 120 credits per epoch, a 33-epoch payback, never arriving. An honest agent buys one permit, keeps earnings whole.
